_doc: Reviewer's edits applied on top of the reader agents' cases (harness/court_run.py merge). Each edit says why. 'net income -> 4BA': where a court states only a net income (revenu brut global, revenu net imposable), it is entered in box 4BA (net property income under the real regime), which enters the taxable income one for one; this changes the RFR and social levies but not the income-tax figures scored.

drop_figures.RBG: entered as the input (4BA), so not a test

assumptions_add: reviewer: revenu brut global 24 935 entered as net income in 4BA (enters RBG one for one); the court's own figures start from it

reviewer: ordinary net income 168 870 entered in 4BA; the stock-option gain (taxed as salary) entered as salary under the quotient (M aliases RAJ amount, NAJ = 4 years; M's 0XX box is a control-only field that the computation ignores); the administration's version taxes it at once as salary (1AJ); TAX_DELTA = tax without quotient - tax with quotient. Lean has no quotient input: out of its scope
reviewer: revenu net global 62 412 entered in 4BA; both spouses taken as over 65 (they claimed the elderly allowance; ages not stated) so that the test is the income ceiling
reviewer: revenu net global 90 444 entered in 4BA; both spouses taken as over 65 (see 2021)
reviewer: the court's 4 465 is the home-employment credit plus the union-dues credit, i.e. all the credits of the return: scored against the programs' total credits
reviewer: household and income not stated; a probe salary of 200 000 added so that the tax exceeds the reduction
reviewer: household and income not stated; a probe salary of 50 000 (single) added to both versions so that the tax exceeds the reduction and the 20 % limit does not bind
reviewer: only the 10 % deduction on the salary (between floor and cap, hence year-independent) is scored, on proxy years

assumptions_add: reviewer: the 'revenu imposable' 64 575 (base of the 20 % limit) entered as net income in 4BA; 66 % rate and 20 % limit unchanged 2015-2025, so run on proxy years; the retained base and the carry-forward are M variables (BON, REPDON); Lean outputs only the reduction imputed, which the tax caps here

assumptions_add: reviewer: the half-part of art. 195, 1 f requires the declarant to be over 74; birth year not stated, 1940 entered (first run used the runner's default 1980 and gave 1 part: a mapping error, not a program error)

reviewer: for a married couple the veteran half-part is box S (0AS: spouse or declarant veteran over 74), not W (0AW, the box for a person filing alone); first run with 0AW gave 2 parts: a mapping error
